intro: Ecuador is a presidential republic facing a fight against drug gangs.

chapters.title: How it works
text: The president is elected for four years. The National Assembly has a single chamber. Daniel Noboa was re-elected in 2025 and has used the army against gangs.

chapters.title: Nature's rights
text: In 2008 Ecuador became the first country to give nature rights in its constitution.
